_source: the user's own plan "Bone Warbringer" (2026-10-27), checked against poe2-pilot's gem and tree data
_note: Warrior -> Warbringer with physical bone spells and a shield (two one-handed maces with slams for levels 1-8); no guide, untested in game. The .build is written by tools/make_warbringer_bone.py. Played with one weapon set (wand + shield): weapon set points all go to it, and since the planner does not model them their notables (Defensive Stance, Sudden Escalation, Constricting, Radial Force: 20 points) are hints here. Corrections to the plan: Eroding Chains breaks 50% of armour per Pin (not 100%); Detonate Dead gets no Brutality (it also deals fire damage); Renly's Training needs a shield; Powerful Casting, Deadly Thorns and Shelter from the Rain are Oracle-only nodes, replaced by Defensive Reflexes and Constricting. Self-found: no uniques.

route._why: Sekhemas gives Warbringer (Anvil's Weight) before Bonestorm carries bosses

ascendancy._order: Anvil's Weight -> Imploding Impacts -> Renly's Training -> Jade Heritage

gear._lines: at most 2 per level are shown (toast and Alt+Q)
